identity.notes: The official location page and its directly linked SkyTab ordering surface identify the same operating restaurant, street address, and 301-294-0200 phone number. Other Clyde's locations are separate and are not merged.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: The current food menus identify select products as Vegetarian or Gluten-Friendly.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: These are dietary menu labels, not comprehensive allergen-absence guarantees.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Clyde's says it takes care to avoid cross-contact but that the kitchen is not completely gluten-free.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This facility-level caution must not be expanded into blanket product-level may-contain claims.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Guests are instructed to inform their server before ordering if they have a food allergy or dietary need.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This is a communication instruction, not a safety guarantee.

evidence.excerpt: Current two-page Tower Oaks Lunch & Dinner PDF supplies the exhaustive lunch/dinner food surface, selected nonalcoholic beverages, dietary labels, and the allergy/cross-contact notice.
Current two-page Tower Oaks Brunch PDF supplies the current brunch surface and repeats the dietary legend and allergy/cross-contact notice.
Official Tower Oaks Lodge page confirms the operating Rockville restaurant, address, phone, hours, menu tabs, current PDF links, and direct SkyTab ordering link.

Current Tower Oaks beverage document was inspected in full. Named spirit-free cocktails, nonalcoholic beer and sparkling wine, waters, sodas, juices, coffee, and tea are in scope; alcohol-only sections are excluded.
Current Tower Oaks dessert document supplies the exhaustive dessert and classic milkshake surface; boozy milkshakes and other alcohol-only sections are excluded.

The official Order Online link resolves to Clyde's Tower Oaks Lodge at 2 Preserve Pkwy, Rockville. Its live categories corroborate the core menu and add four current named products absent from the official PDFs.
Official locations directory distinguishes Tower Oaks Lodge from Clyde's sibling restaurants, including Chevy Chase, Georgetown, Mark Center, and Willow Creek Farm.
